carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs within its silhouette, showing lower spatial density compared to the lateral flank pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal remoras are visible, with several attached to the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin and others swimming in close proximity beneath the shark.
